context: D14 dispositioned (double-verified: field misdiagnosis — override-on-provisional has always worked; real defect is file-wins ingest silently reverting uncommitted lifecycle writes) and fixed TDD: updateStatus reports persisted, override reads back post-state and fails loudly, ingest counts lifecycle_reverts. 1634 tests green.
rationale: throwing would break callers that legitimately tolerate absence (housekeeping backfill skips dangling records by design); the return value eliminates the silent no-op at the contract level while leaving tolerant callers untouched, and tsc forces every implementation and the Exporting wrapper through the change.
summary: Chose to change IDecisionStore.updateStatus to return {persisted: boolean} rather than throw NOT_FOUND on missing targets
